scope: Catalog reconciliation: remaining distinct cast-exclusive and boss/raid skill gaps

records.name: Celestial Hammer
records.effect: Fused Zamasu charges and slams the opponent with a fist, sending them flying.

records.name: Giant Storm
records.effect: Creates a large tracking explosion beneath the opponent.

records.name: Gigantic Slam
records.effect: Grab attack followed by a Ki Wave slam; leaves the user open.

records.name: Bloody Sauce
records.effect: Wave of purple Ki blasts; can poison or slow targets.

notes: Reconciled against prior research batches. Spiral of Condemnation was removed because it is already covered by Batch 271. Bloody Sauce has no DLC requirement established; Expert Mission 20 is a base-game Expert Mission and is not evidence of an Extra Pack requirement. Remaining records are distinct canonical identities.
